title: 第十一章 杀人诛心第十二章 各怀鬼胎
slug: 凡人修仙苟在废丹房我偷偷成仙了
content_zh:
刘二探出的手，又刁又狠，根本不给李狗蛋反应时间。
但李狗蛋身体毕竟有九十八缕灵气。
面对危险，灵气自行运转，双手护在胸前想要硬抗。
然而。
一直潜伏在他体内毒素，随着灵气运转开始加速蔓延。
“嘶！”
胸口骤然传来一阵钻心剧痛。
紧接着，那股毒素顺经脉直冲丹田，硬生生将他刚提起来的一口灵气冲得七零八落！
李狗蛋大惊。
关键时刻，修为崩了！
“砰！”
一声闷响。
刘二这一抓，结结实实打在他胸上。
李狗蛋如断线风筝，毫无抵抗之力倒飞出去，重重砸在泥坑里，激起一片浑浊脏水。
“啪嗒。”
那只绣花鞋也从他怀里掉落，滚落在泥泞中。
这一幕，震惊在场所有人。
包括角落里的许天。
他料到李狗蛋会私藏，但没想到已是到了贴身把玩的程度。
“狗蛋呐狗蛋，你还真是个情种。”

许天在阴影中坏笑。
“噗！”
喷出一口鲜血，李狗蛋满脸骇然与不解。
TMD怎么回事？
老子的灵气怎么突然断了？
一定是这鞋子！
三丫这婊子......难道在鞋上做了手脚？
“哟，还真是女人东西。”
捡起那只绣花鞋，张麻子放在鼻端贪婪嗅了嗅，脸上露出一抹淫笑：
“合欢峰的料子.......”
“李狗蛋，老子们不在时候，你吃得挺好啊。”
捂着胸口，李狗蛋感觉体内毒气乱窜，那种疼痛让他根本站不起来。
看着两个护卫眼中的贪婪，他知大势已去。
虽心中万般不舍，为了保命，只能忍痛割爱。
“大人这说的哪里话......”
“是......是小的孝敬二位大人的......”
他颤抖着说道。
“孝敬？”
刘二瞥了一眼像死狗一样的李狗蛋，满脸嘲讽：
“区区一个凡人，看着挺唬人，怎么连老子随手一下都挡不住？”

“废物就是废物。只要没成气旋，你在老子眼里，连垃圾都不如！”
content_en:
Liu Er's extended hand was cunning and cruel, giving Li Goudan no time to react.
But after all, Li Goudan's body has ninety-eight rays of spiritual energy.
In the face of danger, the spiritual energy circulates on its own, and he protects his chest with his hands in an attempt to resist.
However.
The toxins that had been lurking in his body began to spread at an accelerated pace as the spiritual energy circulated.
"Hiss!"
There was a sudden sharp pain in my chest.
Immediately afterwards, the toxin rushed straight to the Dantian along the meridians, and forcibly washed away the spiritual energy he had just lifted!
Li Goudan was shocked.
At the critical moment, the cultivation base collapsed!
"Bang!"
There was a muffled sound.
Liu Er's grasp hit him firmly on the chest.
Like a kite with its string cut off, Li Goudan flew backwards without any resistance and hit the mud pit hard, stirring up a cloud of turbid water.
"Crack."
The embroidered shoe also fell from his arms and rolled down in the mud.
This scene shocked everyone present.
Including Xu Tian in the corner.
He expected that Li Goudan would hide it privately, but he didn't expect that he would play with it personally.
"Goudan, Goudan, you are such a sweetheart."
Xu Tian smiled evilly in the shadows.
"Poof!"
Spurting out a mouthful of blood, Li Goudan's face was full of shock and confusion.
What the hell is going on?
Why did my spiritual energy suddenly break?
It must be these shoes!
Sanya, this bitch...did she do something to her shoes?
"Oh, it's really a woman's thing."
Picking up the embroidered shoe, Zhang Mazi put it to his nose and sniffed greedily, with a lustful smile on his face:
"Materials from Hehuan Peak..."
"Li Goudan, you ate very well while I was away."
Holding his chest, Li Goudan felt the poisonous energy rushing through his body. The pain made him unable to stand up at all.
Seeing the greed in the eyes of the two guards, he knew the situation was over.
Although I was deeply reluctant to give up, in order to save my life, I could only reluctantly give up my love.
"What are you talking about, sir..."
"Yes... I'm just trying to show my respect to the two adults..."
he said shakily.
"Filial piety?"
Liu Er glanced at Li Goudan, who was like a dead dog, with a mocking look on his face:
"He's just a mortal, he looks so bluffing, how come he can't even stop me with a casual move?"
"Trash is trash. As long as it doesn't turn into a cyclone, in my eyes, you are worse than trash!"
